claim: Web Summit published its seventh annual Gender in Tech report on 27 October 2026.
The Web Summit Lisbon summit is held 9 to 12 November.
Web Summit surveyed more than 1,000 women across its global tech community for the report.
84% of survey respondents report women in leadership at their company.
35% of respondents say women are represented at C-suite level.
Half of respondents still experience sexism.
58% of respondents say they are not paid fairly compared with men.
42% of respondents have considered reducing their hours, stepping away from leadership, or leaving tech.
52% of women aged 35 to 44 have considered reducing their hours, stepping away from leadership, or leaving tech.
Last year 75% of women believed AI could help make tech more equal, and this year 31% say it has.
